vocabulary.meaning_en: to finally succeed in agreeing a business deal
vocabulary.example: After two meetings, we clinched the deal.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a business agreement between two sides
vocabulary.example: We signed a deal with a new supplier.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a written legal agreement
vocabulary.example: Please read the contract before you sign it.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to write your name on a document to show you agree
vocabulary.note_en: The g is silent: /saɪn/. Noun: signature.
vocabulary.example: The manager signed the contract this morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a journey you make for your work
vocabulary.example: She is away on a business trip to Paris.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a company that sells the same things as you
vocabulary.example: Our competitor has lower prices.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an amount of money or a deal that someone suggests
vocabulary.example: They received a better offer from another company.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to offer a lower price than someone else
vocabulary.example: We can beat the price of any other shop.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an amount taken off the normal price
vocabulary.example: If you order more, we can give you a 10% discount.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to ask a company to send you goods
vocabulary.example: The client placed an order for 500 boxes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to repeat the main points of something said before
vocabulary.example: Let me recap what we agreed on the phone.

vocabulary.meaning_en: meeting in person, not by phone or email
vocabulary.example: It is easier to discuss prices face-to-face.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make someone believe or agree with something
vocabulary.example: She convinced the client to buy more.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person you work with
vocabulary.example: This is my colleague, Tom.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give some of your time to someone, although you are busy
vocabulary.example: Thank you for sparing the time to meet us.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something a company makes and sells
vocabulary.example: This lemon is our best product.

vocabulary.meaning_en: strong and lasting a long time
vocabulary.example: These chairs are hard-wearing.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to add something extra for free when someone buys something
vocabulary.example: If you buy the laptop, we'll throw in a free bag.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small amount of a product you get without paying, to try it
vocabulary.example: The shop gave us a free sample of the new tea.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a promise that a product is good and will be fixed or replaced if not
vocabulary.example: The printer comes with a two-year guarantee.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the good feeling when you get what you wanted
vocabulary.example: Customer satisfaction is very important to us.

vocabulary.meaning_en: unhappy because something was not as good as you hoped
vocabulary.example: I was disappointed with the service.

vocabulary.meaning_en: feeling or showing thanks
vocabulary.example: I'm grateful for your help.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to take goods to the place where someone wants them
vocabulary.example: We will deliver the order in two weeks.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not direct or obvious; done in a clever, gentle way
vocabulary.example: Be subtle when you ask for a bigger order.

fine_lines.title: deal vs contract
fine_lines.explanation_ar: deal هو الاتفاق نفسه بين الطرفين (قد يكون شفهيًا)، أما contract فهو الوثيقة الرسمية المكتوبة التي توقَّع لإثبات الاتفاق.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A deal is the agreement itself (it can be spoken). A contract is the official written document that you sign to make the deal legal.

examples.sentence: OK, I think we have a deal.
Could you sign the contract, please?

fine_lines.title: discount vs offer
fine_lines.explanation_ar: discount هو المبلغ الذي يُخصم من السعر. offer هو ما يقترحه طرف على آخر (سعر أو صفقة)، وقد يتضمن خصمًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A discount is money taken off the price. An offer is what one side suggests to the other (a price or a deal); it may include a discount.

examples.sentence: We give a 5% discount on big orders.

expressions.phrase: Thank you for sparing the time to see us.
expressions.meaning_en: Thank you for giving us some of your time.
expressions.example: Thank you for sparing the time to see us, Mr Brown.

expressions.phrase: Each lemon comes with a satisfaction guarantee - I know you won't be disappointed.
expressions.meaning_ar: كل منتج يأتي مع ضمان الرضا، وأنا واثق أنك لن تخيب أملك.
expressions.meaning_en: Every product has a promise that you will be happy with it.
expressions.example: Each phone comes with a satisfaction guarantee - I know you won't be disappointed.

expressions.phrase: I would be grateful if you could just sign the contract.
expressions.meaning_ar: سأكون ممتنًا لو تفضّلت بتوقيع العقد.
expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to ask someone to sign.
expressions.example: I would be grateful if you could just sign the contract here.

expressions.phrase: It was a pleasure doing business with you.
expressions.meaning_ar: كان التعامل معك من دواعي سروري.
expressions.meaning_en: A polite phrase at the end of a successful deal.
expressions.example: Thank you. It was a pleasure doing business with you.

expressions.phrase: I think you have a deal.
expressions.example: It sounds good. I think you have a deal.

expressions.phrase: As I said on the phone, we can beat that.
expressions.meaning_ar: كما قلت على الهاتف، يمكننا تقديم سعر أفضل من ذلك.
expressions.meaning_en: We can offer a better price than the other company.
expressions.example: As I said on the phone, we can beat that price.

expressions.phrase: We'll get them to you as quickly as we can.
expressions.meaning_en: We will deliver them very soon.
expressions.example: We'll get the boxes to you as quickly as we can.

expressions.phrase: You just need to place an order of 10,000.
expressions.meaning_ar: كل ما عليك هو أن تطلب 10,000 قطعة.
expressions.example: To get this price, you just need to place an order of 500.

grammar.title: Polite requests: I would be grateful if you could…
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما نطلب شيئًا بطريقة رسمية ومهذبة نستخدم: I would be grateful if you could + الفعل في صيغة المصدر (بدون to). وهي أكثر لباقة من Please sign أو Sign the contract.
grammar.explanation_en: To make a formal, polite request, use: I would be grateful if you could + base verb. It is softer than 'Please sign' or 'Sign the contract'.
examples: I would be grateful if you could sign the contract.
I would be grateful if you could send me the price list.
We would be grateful if you could reply by Friday.

grammar.title: Thank you for + verb-ing
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد Thank you for نستخدم الفعل مع ing (أو اسمًا): Thank you for sparing the time. لا نقول Thank you for spare.
grammar.explanation_en: After 'Thank you for' use the -ing form of the verb (or a noun): Thank you for sparing the time. Not 'Thank you for spare'.
examples: Thank you for sparing the time to see us.

grammar.title: First conditional for offers: If you…, we can/will…
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم If + المضارع البسيط، ثم will/can + الفعل، لتقديم عرض مشروط: إذا طلبتم أكثر، سنعطيكم خصمًا أكبر.
grammar.explanation_en: Use If + present simple, then will/can + verb, to make a conditional offer: If you order more, we can give you a bigger discount.
examples: If you order more, we can offer a bigger discount.
If you sign today, we will deliver next week.
If you buy 10,000, we'll throw in a free sample.

questions.question: What does 'clinch the deal' mean?
choices: to finally agree and complete a deal
questions.explanation_ar: clinch the deal تعني حسم الصفقة وإتمامها.
questions.explanation_en: To clinch a deal means to finally succeed in agreeing it.

questions.question: Complete: 'I would be grateful if you ___ just sign the contract.'
questions.explanation_ar: التركيب الصحيح: I would be grateful if you could + الفعل.
questions.explanation_en: The pattern is: I would be grateful if you could + base verb.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: Thank you to sparing the time to see us.
Thank you for spare the time to see us.
Thank you for sparing the time to see us.
Thank you for spared the time to see us.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد Thank you for نستخدم الفعل مع ing.
questions.explanation_en: After 'Thank you for' we use the -ing form.

questions.question: What do you say at the end of a successful deal?
choices: Please leave the talking to me.
It was a pleasure doing business with you.
questions.explanation_ar: هذه العبارة المهذبة تُقال بعد إتمام الصفقة.
questions.explanation_en: This polite phrase is used after a deal is done.

questions.question: Tom says: 'We can even throw in a free sample.' What does 'throw in' mean here?
questions.explanation_ar: throw in تعني إضافة شيء مجاني مع الصفقة.
questions.explanation_en: Throw in means to add something extra for free.

questions.question: A company that sells the same products as you is a ___.
questions.explanation_en: A competitor sells the same things as you.

questions.question: Complete: 'If you order more, we ___ give you a bigger discount.'
questions.explanation_ar: في الجملة الشرطية الأولى نستخدم can/will + الفعل.
questions.explanation_en: In the first conditional use can/will + verb.

questions.question: Which word means 'a promise that the product is good'?
questions.explanation_en: A guarantee is a promise that a product is good.

questions.question: What is the difference between a deal and a contract?
choices: A deal is always written; a contract is spoken.
They are always exactly the same.
A contract is the written document that you sign; a deal is the agreement.
questions.explanation_ar: contract هو الوثيقة المكتوبة الموقّعة، و deal هو الاتفاق نفسه.
questions.explanation_en: A contract is the signed written document; a deal is the agreement.

questions.question: The narrator tells Anna to 'recap' what she said on the phone. What does 'recap' mean?
questions.explanation_ar: recap تعني إعادة ذكر النقاط الرئيسية.
questions.explanation_en: Recap means to repeat the main points.
